simple.summary: חוּג (chûwg) means to describe a circle First listed occurrence: Job 26 10.

definitions.full: H2328. chug [ חוּג ] verb draw round, make a circle (Aramaic circumivit ; noun , חוּגְתָּא , circle, vault of heavens ) — Qal Perfect מים עלפֿני חָג חֹק Job 26:10 (compare Prov 8:27 ), hath drawn as a circle a bound, etc., of the horizon-line.
